assumptions: PE values and 15.8bn earnings are selected old model assumptions, not present observations or adopted fair values.
A-share reference price times total historical shares is a comparison algebra amount, not observed combined A+H market capitalization.
Fixed old shares, no separate cash add-on, dividends, financing or dilution effects.
No return horizon, probability, annualization, hurdle, watch boundary or Human action is established.
Cash comparison uses group OCF and deducted parent profit; it is not a consolidated earnings-to-cash reconciliation or FCFE.
Extra inventory assumption is new cash use relative to old OCF scale, never deducting old end inventory twice.

price.qualification: saved Sep30 backward context; not S0, a new quote, or realized return

supply_cash_predecessor.classification: inherited prior conditional analysis, not new event
